newsitem.title: USA: Genesco sees Q3 charge of $1.7 mln.
newsitem.headline: Genesco sees Q3 charge of $1.7 mln.

text.p: Genesco Inc said Thursday it expects to record a one-time charge to earnings of about $1.7 million in the third quarter ending October 31, 1996.
The charge would be due to realigning its manufacturing operations as part of an overall strategy to focus on marketing and global sourcing, a statement from the company said.
The plan contemplates the closing of the company's Hohenwald, Tenn., western boot manufacturing plant by July 1997.

Genesco said it will make investments estimated at $1.1 million in systems intended to lower inventory levels, speed response times and improve quality in its remaining two boot plants and one Johnston & Murphy dress shoe plant.

The company said initial indications are that operating results for the quarter ending October 31, 1996, will show continued improvement in sales, same store growth and continued improvement in earnings, even with the one-time charge, as compared to last year's third quarter.
The company said it expects to announce its third quarter results in November.
